events.title: Taylor Riggs: Trump’s Nvidia Call & 10% Credit Card Cap Warning
events.description: Taylor Riggs unpacks Nvidia’s CEO drama and warns why a 10% credit card rate cap could backfire. The Big Money Show co-host joins Annie Frey to tackle two huge stories hitting your wallet and 401(k). After Nvidia lost $2 trillion amid CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged CCP spy scandal, President Trump called the board—raising real free-market questions. Plus, Taylor sounds off on the bipartisan push from Trump, Sen. Josh Hawley, and Sen. Elizabeth Warren to cap credit card rates at 10%. Key takeaways from this interview: • Why Nvidia’s rollercoaster directly hits your 401(k), pension, and index funds. • Is Trump’s call to Nvidia’s board smart national security or government meddling in free enterprise? • Good debt vs. bad debt—and why capping credit card rates is a price control ("ask Venezuela how that's working"). • How a 10% cap could cut off everyday borrowers and push them toward loan sharks. • Why populism is bringing the far right and far left closer together than you think. Don't miss a minute of straight talk—follow and subscribe to The Annie Frey Show, leave a 5-star review, and stream the full episode now!
